idea-plugin.name: Test Space
idea-plugin.description:
Make Java, Python, and Rust test names readable without changing your source code.

Test Space displays underscores as spaces and optionally splits camelCase. Method references, refactoring, and test runner names keep the original identifier.

  • Supports JUnit 3 TestCase methods, JUnit 4, JUnit Jupiter, TestNG method annotations, and composed test annotations.
  • Supports standard pytest/unittest discovery and Rust test attributes.
  • Preserves acronyms and names referenced by the test body when splitting camelCase.
  • Expands names for editing when the caret touches them.
  • Offers a custom color scheme style or standard editor folding.

Configure under Settings | Editor | Test Space.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial release: readable Java test names, configurable formatting, custom styling, and caret-aware expansion.
